component.name: NotePadPQ
component.summary: Advanced text editor with syntax highlighting, LaTeX support and plugins

description.p: NotePadPQ is a modern, cross-platform text editor built with Python 3, PyQt6 and QScintilla. Inspired by Notepad++ but runs natively on Linux, Windows and FreeBSD without Wine or emulation layers.

ul.li: Syntax highlighting for 40+ languages with auto-detection
Full LaTeX editing suite: autocomplete, real-time checker, SyncTeX, PDF preview
Language Server Protocol (LSP) client for code intelligence
Split view, multi-cursor, macros, bookmarks, code folding
Integrated build system with configurable profiles
Markdown, reStructuredText and HTML live preview
Spell checker for Italian, English, German, French, Spanish
Plugin architecture with built-in AI assistant, PDF viewer, hex viewer, spreadsheet, rich text editor, Git integration and more
Interface available in Italian, English, German, French, Spanish, Polish

description.p: Startup performance: plugins now load one per event-loop tick so the window appears immediately. Language auto-detection from system locale. Simplified build profiles list.
